summary: Senstar Technologies filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting first-quarter 2026 financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026. Revenue was $8.1 million with a net loss of $0.8 million, compared to $8.4 million revenue and $1.0 million net income in the prior-year quarter. The filing notes the company completed the acquisition of Blickfeld on February 13, 2026, but that acquisition is not a new event; the 6-K is a routine earnings release. No special situation or deal terms are disclosed.
